lessons: Premise finding is wrong: gates.run_gates passes each gate the workspace Path. Check and the merge rerun both run CHECK_GATES on the candidate worktree at branch head after rebase. Read the routed conduct with Path.read_bytes() there; chupa/git.py is not needed.

Treat 'committed conduct-file bytes on the candidate branch' (19.P6.core-drift-activation) as the clean candidate worktree's file bytes. Render the template from that same workspace's plan section 17, not from the serving engine's repo.

Do not file a scope-fence premise again for byte-exact retrieval. hostfiles.py already reads with path.read_bytes() (line 119), so a non-UTF-8 committed byte survives a worktree read. Spend this attempt on the wiring, the fixture adoption and the named tests.

Wire core_drift into stages.CHECK_GATES. The merge rerun picks it up through run_gates(CHECK_GATES, evidence, worktree) after the rebase. Rely on the shipped hard default in DEFAULT_GATE_SEVERITY and do not add a severity override.

Render CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md mechanically with hostfiles.render, keeping their full existing bytes as the remainder, and commit them. Repair each fenced test and eval host builder so it commits rendered conduct for its own routes before Check/merge.
